sloka: निरीक्ष्य बलमुद्विग्नमङ्गदो राक्षसार्दितम्।वेगं चक्रे महाबाहुः समुद्र इव पर्वणि ।। ६.९९.५ ।।
transliteration: nirīkṣya balamudvignamaṅgado rākṣasārditam।vegaṁ cakre mahābāhuḥ samudra iva parvaṇi ।। 6.99.5 ।।

translations.english: Observing the army oppressed by the Rakshasa leader, Angada, endowed with broad shoulders, exhibited his might speedily like the ocean on full moon days.
